name: smwsprites-crab
title: Crab
description:
A crab that hides behind the ground and, when Mario is near, jumps out of it, acting like a green beach koopa or like a spiny depending on extra bit. Its graphics also change depending on the extra bit. Graphics made by Gregor.

(Rykon-V73): Converted the sprite and its extra bit version into .json format. Before, the GFX of the crab were a pain to find. Now it's made to be easy.
